about.title: A full-service clinic in G-9 Markaz
paragraphs: Zain Dental Clinic is on Rohtas Road in G-9 Markaz, below D Watson near the Karachi Company bus stop. It is easy to reach and easy to park near, two things that matter when you are coming back for a course of treatment.

Nine treatments are offered under one roof, from a routine clean through to implants and surgical impactions. That means a case which turns out to be more complicated than expected stays with the same team rather than being referred on.

items.name: Amna Islam
items.quote: I went for RCT today. Dr. Zain is so professional and decent, and it was a painless process. I have had root canals many times before but this was my best experience. They have a modern X-ray machine which helped a lot during the process.

items.name: Arsal Sohail
items.quote: Dr. Iqra is incredibly thorough and takes the time to explain every step of the procedure, which really puts you at ease. The clinic is spotless, modern, and the staff is very welcoming.

items.name: Hira Fiaz
items.quote: I always appreciate how they are on time, the hygienists are professional and friendly, and Dr. Iqra takes the time to answer my questions. Super caring, gentle, and they have a way to make your visit a little more relaxing.

items.name: Aurangzeb Qureshi
items.quote: I had my scaling, polishing and crown done and am very happy with the treatment. Dr. Iqra explained everything clearly. The treatment was smooth and pain-free and the clinic was clean and modern.

items.name: Shoaib Hussain
items.quote: I had scaling and polishing done by Dr. Laiba. She is a very hard-working and skilled dentist. She diagnosed my problem accurately and gave me the right treatment. I am satisfied with my treatment.

items.name: Zeeshan Malik
items.quote: Just visited today for scaling and polishing. Such a clean and aesthetic clinic, and the staff is so professional. Will visit again.

items.name: Saima Sadiq
items.quote: Very competent and highly professional. The clinic is on an easy approach and neat and clean. It even opens on Sunday to facilitate patients who cannot spare time on weekdays. The doctor not only knows how to treat but also follows up with the patient afterwards.

items.name: Faisal Abbasi
items.quote: Dr. Zain is a top-notch dentist, highly skilled, professional and compassionate. He took the time to explain everything clearly and make sure I was comfortable throughout the entire process.

items.question: Where is the clinic?
items.answer: On Rohtas Road in G-9 Markaz, Islamabad, below D Watson and near the Karachi Company bus stop. Use the 'Get directions' link on this page and it will take you straight there.

items.question: Are you open on Sunday?
items.answer: Yes. We keep Sunday appointments available for patients who cannot get away during the working week.

items.question: Is a root canal painful?
items.answer: It should not be. We take a digital X-ray first so the tooth is properly assessed before we start, and patients who have had root canals elsewhere frequently tell us this was their easiest experience of the procedure.

items.question: How do I book?
items.answer: WhatsApp is quickest. Send us a message with what you need and we'll confirm a time. You can also call the clinic on 0314 5477439.

items.question: Do you do braces and aligners?
items.answer: Yes, both fixed braces and clear aligners, with regular review appointments through the course of treatment.

items.question: What if my treatment turns out to be more complicated?
items.answer: It stays with us. Root canals, extractions, surgical impactions, implants and crown work are all done in this clinic, so you are not sent somewhere else halfway through.
